champion.tips: HWEI TIPS AND TRICKS Fight in areas of the map that are quite tight, as this allows you to deal a lot of AOE damage. Playing around your Ultimate R and E , especially in the mid and late game, is really important. When possible, try to abuse the enemy with auto-attacks, as this will help you win trades. But in the Support role, you are mostly a poke champion.
champion.builds: THE BEST HWEI BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Hwei Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Legend: Haste and Presence of Mind in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Blackfire Torch. For your last 3 items, you should build Liandry's Torment, Morellonomicon and finish with Rabadon's Deathcap. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 49.7% winrate over 2 723 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Dark Harvest as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Deep Ward and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, and Manaflow Band with Transcendence in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Blackfire Torch as a third item. You want to finish the build with Liandry's Torment, Horizon Focus and Cryptbloom. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 52.4% win rate across 164 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Hwei Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, First Strike, Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery and Jack Of All Trades as your primary rune tree, and Manaflow Band with Gathering Storm as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Blackfire Torch as third item. The last 3 options are Liandry's Torment, Shadowflame and Morellonomicon. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 54.3% win rate over 138 matches played. Situational Hwei Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Hwei build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Hwei runes page.
